Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN*, C.K. PRASAD
C WILD LIFE (PROTECTION) ACT, 1972: Object of its enactment - Discussed. s.2(27) - Whether sandalwood (Santa/um album Linn) D stated to be an endangered species, be declared as a "specified plant" within the meaning included in the Schedule VI of the Act - Held: Indian sandalwood (Santa/um album Linn) is not included in the species listed in Appendix-II of CITES, however red E sandalwood (Pterocarpus Santalinus) is seen included in Appendix-I/ - At the ~ame time International Union for Conservation of Nature
